node.title: Paid normalization-ceiling anchor descent
node.statement: Full-generic pair/shared rank2s-3/s sources with s>=4, actual normalization nu<=H and p>D can retain every coordinate. High-normalization exits have the proved branch-weighted inner-centre budget; generic exits retain their original U/G prices. The exact inequality A*Omega<=N*C+(kappa+3)*(F-C)_++B_geo*(T-C)_+ permits overlap and requires no B_geo<A selection denominator. Image-degree monotonicity, simultaneous floor-quotient intervals, degree prefixes and v endpoints give uniform finite envelopes. No source payment is assumed.
